rabbi.meaning: spiritual leader of a Jewish congregation

racer.meaning: someone who drives racing cars at high speeds

radar.meaning: a system that uses radio waves to detect objects
radar.example: the plane showed up on radar

radii.meaning: plural of radius: lines from the centre of a circle to its edge

radio.meaning: broadcasting by radio waves; the device that receives it

rainy.meaning: (of weather) wet by periods of rain

raise.meaning: raise the level or amount of something

rajah.meaning: a prince or king in India

rally.meaning: a large gathering; to recover; a long exchange in tennis

ranch.meaning: farm consisting of a large tract of land along with facilities needed to raise livestock (especially cattle)

range.meaning: the extent between limits; a selection; a stove

rapid.meaning: done or occurring in a brief period of time
rapid.example: a rapid rise through the ranks

raspy.meaning: unpleasantly harsh or grating in sound

ratio.meaning: the relative magnitudes of two quantities (usually expressed as a quotient)

raven.meaning: large black bird with a straight bill and long wedge-shaped tail

reach.meaning: stretch out to touch; arrive at

react.meaning: show a response or a reaction to something

ready.meaning: completely prepared or in condition for immediate action or use or progress

realm.meaning: a kingdom; an area of activity

rearm.example: After the war, the defeated country was not rearmed by the victors

rebel.meaning: a person who fights against authority

recap.meaning: a summary at the end that repeats the substance of a longer discussion

recut.meaning: to cut again, especially to re-edit a film

reedy.meaning: having a tone of a reed instrument

refit.meaning: outfitting a ship again (by repairing or replacing parts)

regal.meaning: belonging to or befitting a supreme ruler

reign.example: Henry VIII reigned for a long time

relax.meaning: become less tense, rest, or take one's ease
relax.example: He relaxed in the hot tub

relay.meaning: pass along; a race run in stages by a team

relic.meaning: an antiquity that has survived from the distant past

renal.meaning: of or relating to the kidneys

renew.meaning: reestablish on a new, usually improved, basis or make new or like new
renew.example: We renewed our friendship after a hiatus of twenty years

repel.meaning: cause to move back by force or influence

resin.meaning: a sticky substance from trees, or a synthetic version used in plastics

retch.meaning: eject the contents of the stomach through the mouth

revue.meaning: a variety show with topical sketches and songs and dancing and comedians

rhino.meaning: a huge thick-skinned animal with one or two horns on its nose

rhyme.meaning: correspondence in the sounds of two or more lines (especially final sounds)

rider.meaning: a traveler who actively rides an animal (as a horse or camel)

ridge.meaning: a long narrow natural elevation or striation

rifle.meaning: a shoulder firearm with a long barrel and a rifled bore
rifle.example: he lifted the rifle to his shoulder and fired

right.meaning: correct; the opposite of left; a lawful entitlement

rigid.meaning: incapable of or resistant to bending

rinse.meaning: wash off soap or remaining dirt

riper.meaning: comparative of ripe: more fully grown and ready to eat
riper.example: the mangoes are riper this week

risen.meaning: (of e.g. celestial bodies) above the horizon

risky.example: extremely risky going out in the tide and fog

rival.meaning: a person or team you compete with

river.meaning: a large natural stream of water (larger than a creek)
river.example: the river was navigable for 50 miles

rivet.meaning: a metal pin that joins plates; to hold attention completely

roast.meaning: cook with dry heat, usually in an oven

robin.meaning: small Old World songbird with a reddish breast

robot.meaning: a mechanism that can move automatically

rotor.meaning: the rotating armature of a motor or generator

rouge.meaning: makeup consisting of a pink or red powder applied to the cheeks

rough.meaning: having or caused by an irregular surface

round.meaning: having the shape or form of a circle

route.meaning: an established line of travel or access

royal.meaning: of or relating to or indicative of or issued or performed by a king or queen or other monarch

ruddy.meaning: inclined to a healthy reddish color often associated with outdoor life

ruler.meaning: a flat strip for measuring and drawing lines; a person who governs

rumor.meaning: gossip (usually a mixture of truth and untruth) passed around by word of mouth

rupee.meaning: the currency of India (also Pakistan, Nepal and Sri Lanka)

rural.meaning: living in or characteristic of farming or country life

rusty.meaning: covered with or consisting of rust
